appeal.letter:
Subject: Appeal against Denial of Claim ccd0ca16-850b-a065-ee82-cc257910018a – Pre‑Existing Disease Waiting Period

Claim Details:
Member Name: Nathanael Hansen
Policy: Suraksha Silver Individual Health Plan (Plan Code SGH‑SILVER) – Coverage effective 17‑02‑2024
Date of Service: 25‑04‑2026 (Home nebulizer for chronic sinusitis)
Claim Amount: INR 371.72
Encounter Class: AMB

Grounds for Appeal:
The denial relies on a pre‑existing disease waiting period, yet chronic sinusitis was first diagnosed on 25‑04‑2026, which is after the policy start date of 17‑02‑2024. According to the policy definition, a condition first diagnosed on or after the policy start date is not a Pre‑Existing Disease and therefore the waiting period does not apply [suraksha_silver_policy#5]. Consequently, the 36‑month waiting period clause is inapplicable to this claim [suraksha_silver_policy#11].

Clinical Necessity:
The treating physician will attach detailed clinical notes confirming that nebulizer therapy was medically necessary for the management of the newly diagnosed chronic sinusitis.

Reference to Denial Standards:
Under the insurer’s own denial standards, the burden of proof lies with the insurer to demonstrate that an exclusion or waiting period is valid, requiring documentary evidence of a diagnosis prior to the policy start date. No such evidence has been provided, and the insurer has not met this burden [claims_procedure_and_grievance#6].

Specific Request:
In view of the above, we request that the denial be rescinded, the claim be re‑processed, and the amount of INR 371.72 be paid in full to the provider. The insurer’s failure to meet the burden of proof under the policy and denial standards obligates reconsideration of this claim [claims_procedure_and_grievance#6].

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Insurance Desk (on behalf of the treating provider)

### 2.2 Pre-Existing Disease (PED)
Pre-Existing Disease means any condition, ailment, injury or disease that was diagnosed by a physician, or for which medical advice or treatment was received, within 48 months PRIOR TO the first policy start date. citations.section: Suraksha Silver Individual Health Plan (Policy Wording) > 4. Waiting Periods > 4.2 Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period
citations.quote:
### 4.2 Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period
Expenses related to a Pre-Existing Disease (as defined in Clause 2.2) are covered only after 36 months of continuous coverage from the first policy start date. This waiting period applies ONLY to conditions meeting the definition in Clause 2.2.

citations.section: Claims Procedure, Denial Standards and Grievance Redressal > C3. Standards for Denial > C3.2 Burden of Proof for Exclusions and Waiting Periods
citations.quote:
### C3.2 Burden of Proof for Exclusions and Waiting Periods
The insurer bears the burden of proving that an exclusion or waiting period applies. For a Pre-Existing Disease denial, the insurer must show documentary evidence that the condition was diagnosed or treated before the policy start date.
